feeds.term: ("Alzheimer Disease"[Mesh]) AND ("Review"[Publication Type]) AND (overview OR introduction OR "current understanding" OR primer OR basics)

drug.title: Comparison of double-blind and open-label decline rates in lecanemab and donanemab trials in Alzheimer's disease.
drug.zh: 双盲与开放标签阶段斜率差异提示仑卡奈单抗长期获益或被高估。

drug.title: Volume change with gantenerumab: Impact of amyloid-related imaging abnormalities and amyloid removal.
drug.zh: gantenerumab致脑实质容积减少主要源于淀粉样蛋白清除，而非ARIA。

drug.title: Real-world implementation of lecanemab in Korean patients at a tertiary memory clinic: Safety, ARIA risk, and early treatment patterns.
drug.zh: 韩国真实世界数据显示仑卡奈单抗输注相关反应常见但ARIA风险可控，认知获益需进一步验证。

drug.title: Plasma P-tau217 for detecting amyloid clearance after donanemab in Alzheimer's disease.
drug.zh: 血浆p-tau217难以可靠监测donanemab治疗后的淀粉样蛋白清除。

drug.title: A randomized phase 1b/2 trial of ABBV-916 in adults with early Alzheimer's disease.
drug.zh: ABBV-916显著降低早期AD患者脑内淀粉样蛋白，但高剂量安全性受限。

drug.title: Lecanemab use in Chinese patients with Alzheimer's disease: a 12-month multicenter real-world study.
drug.zh: 中国患者使用仑卡奈单抗12个月CDR-SB无显著变化，安全性可控但停药率高。

drug.title: Eligibility for Anti-Amyloid Therapies in Patients With Biomarker-Confirmed Atypical Alzheimer Disease Phenotypes.
drug.zh: 非遗忘型不典型阿尔茨海默病多数符合抗淀粉样疗法资格，但需MRI确认。

drug.title: Classification of tau status with machine learning models in amyloid-positive cohorts.
drug.zh: 基于MRI和淀粉样PET特征构建的机器学习模型可有效分类淀粉样阳性人群的tau病理状态。

mech.title: Exercise and Circadian Rhythm Regulation: Mechanisms, Resilience, and Therapeutic Potential for Neurological Diseases.
mech.zh: 运动通过调节生物钟基因与神经炎症，增强昼夜节律稳定性，改善阿尔茨海默病病理。

mech.title: Rising Comorbid Alzheimer's and Hypertension Mortality in Older Adults in the United States: Trends and Disparities From a 21-Year CDC WONDER Analysis (1999-2019).
mech.zh: 美国老年人阿尔茨海默病合并高血压死亡率21年间显著上升，且存在种族与地域差异。

mech.title: Restoration of Neuronal Metabolism and Memory in Alzheimer's Disease by Reprogramming the Exosomal microRNA Network.
mech.zh: 重编程外泌体miRNA网络可恢复AD神经元代谢与记忆，提示代谢缺陷为病理核心。

mech.title: TREM2 as a central immunometabolic hub in Alzheimer's disease: linking microglial states, lipid stress, and disease-stage-specific intervention.
mech.zh: TREM2是连接微胶质状态、脂质应激与AD分期干预的核心免疫代谢枢纽。

mech.title: Amplification of seeding-competent tau aggregates by PMCA in human and experimental tauopathies.
mech.zh: PMCA技术可高效扩增并灵敏检测人及小鼠脑内致病性tau聚集体。

mech.title: A plasma-based protein signature combining NPTXR, ACHE, and p-tau217 predicts progression to symptomatic Alzheimer's disease.
mech.zh: 血浆NPTXR、ACHE联合p-tau217可显著提升无症状期向症状期阿尔茨海默病进展的预测效能。

mech.title: Regional astrocyte dysregulation and altered glymphatic-related markers in Alzheimer's disease frontal cortex.
mech.zh: 阿尔茨海默病额叶皮层星形胶质细胞标志物呈区域失调，且类淋巴相关AQP4相对病理负荷显著降低。

mech.title: Volume change with gantenerumab: Impact of amyloid-related imaging abnormalities and amyloid removal.
mech.zh: gantenerumab所致脑实质体积减少主要源于淀粉样蛋白清除，而非ARIA。

dx.title: Cross-Sectional and Longitudinal Diagnostic Performance of Plasma p-tau217 and p-tau217/Aβ42 in Alzheimer's Disease.
dx.zh: 血浆p-tau217及其与Aβ42比值在横断面和纵向均能准确预测Aβ-PET阳性，可作为AD诊断的可靠血液标志物。

dx.title: The case for FDG-PET and NaF-PET in risk stratification of mild cognitive impairment.
dx.zh: 联合FDG-PET与NaF-PET可优化轻度认知障碍风险分层，捕捉可干预的神经损伤与血管微钙化。

dx.title: A plasma-based protein signature combining NPTXR, ACHE, and p-tau217 predicts progression to symptomatic Alzheimer's disease.
dx.zh: 血浆NPTXR、ACHE联合p-tau217可显著提升无症状期向症状期阿尔茨海默病进展的预测效能。

dx.title: Tracing neuroinflammation in neurodegeneration: insights from a scoping review on biofluid biomarkers.
dx.zh: 生物体液神经炎症标志物可追踪多种神经退行性疾病的诊断、预后与进展。

dx.title: Contribution of Myelin Content to the PET-Measured Amyloid Burden.
dx.journal: Journal of nuclear medicine : official p
dx.zh: 校正髓鞘含量可提升Aβ PET与血浆p-tau217的相关性，提示白质脱靶结合影响皮层定量。

dx.title: Plasma Alzheimer Biomarkers and Diagnostic Decision-Making in Memory Clinics.
dx.zh: 血浆生物标志物组合可提升记忆门诊诊断决策信心与病因判断准确性。

dx.title: Blood Biomarkers of Alzheimer Disease and Rates of Global and Domain-Specific Cognitive Decline.
dx.zh: 血液AD生物标志物可预测整体及特定认知域下降速率，且关联受个体特征影响。

dx.title: Development and validation of an amyloid PET dementia of the Alzheimer's type (DAT) score.
dx.zh: 基于淀粉样PET的3D卷积神经网络可精准识别阿尔茨海默型痴呆，并揭示关键脑区贡献。

prev.title: Factors associated with severe COVID-19 outcomes among adults with at least a primary vaccination schedule: A retrospective cohort study from Alberta, Canada.
prev.zh: 阿尔茨海默病相关论文标题与摘要不匹配，无法提炼核心发现。

prev.title: Stress sensitization: Does childhood adversity modify trauma effects on memory?
prev.zh: 童年逆境会放大成年创伤对晚年记忆衰退的损害，提示应激敏化机制。

prev.title: Relationship between body composition and mortality in older patients with mild cognitive impairment and Alzheimer's disease: NCGG-STORIES.
prev.zh: 低肌肉量而非低BMI，独立预测老年MCI及AD患者死亡风险。

prev.title: Periodontal Status and the Risk of All-Cause Dementia, Alzheimer's Disease and Vascular Dementia in a Community: The Hisayama Study.
prev.zh: 深牙周袋、附着丧失及探诊出血均显著增加全因痴呆及阿尔茨海默病风险。

prev.title: Evaluating inclusion of continuous multivariable cognitive scores for operational enrichment of preclinical Alzheimer's disease trials: a retrospective emulation study.
prev.zh: 连续认知评分可显著提升临床前阿尔茨海默病试验的富集效能与统计把握度。

prev.title: Rising Comorbid Alzheimer's and Hypertension Mortality in Older Adults in the United States: Trends and Disparities From a 21-Year CDC WONDER Analysis (1999-2019).
prev.zh: 美国老年人阿尔茨海默病合并高血压死亡率21年间显著上升，且存在种族与地区差异。

prev.title: GLP-1-based incretin therapy is associated with lower incident Alzheimer's disease and cardiorenal events in adults with documented neuropsychiatric, cognitive, or sensory risk.
prev.zh: GLP-1类药物治疗可显著降低高风险人群阿尔茨海默病及心肾事件发生率。

prev.title: Amyloid-β modulates APOE ε4 effects on cognition but not on targeted structural or functional connectivity measures over 2 years in pre-dementia adults.
prev.zh: Aβ病理可调节APOE ε4对认知的影响，但不影响其两年内对脑结构与功能连接的作用。

intro.title: Gantenerumab for Early Alzheimer's Disease: An Updated Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
intro.zh: 这种药想清掉大脑里的“垃圾蛋白”来延缓老年痴呆，但新数据说效果一般，家里有早期患者的话，别指望它能逆转病情。

intro.title: Pharmacological Effects and Molecular Mechanisms of Lignans in the Treatment of Alzheimer's Disease.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是，木头里的天然成分能多管齐下对付老年痴呆，帮普通人看懂以后吃啥、补啥可能有点用。

intro.title: Oxidative Stress in Alzheimer's Disease: Can Dietary Interventions Provide Neuroprotection?
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是，吃对东西可能帮大脑抗衰老、防老年痴呆，但别指望靠吃治好病，只能当辅助。

intro.title: Blood-Based Biomarkers for Alzheimer Disease in Primary Care: The Gap Between Biology and Clinical Utility.
intro.zh: 抽血查老年痴呆越来越准了，但光靠化验单还不够，得先想清楚查完怎么用，不然容易白花钱还添乱。

intro.title: Revisiting TREM2: from multi-omics signaling networks to clinical translation.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是免疫细胞上的一个“开关”TREM2，它既能防老年痴呆，也可能帮抗癌，看懂它有助于未来新药开发。

intro.title: Brain energy metabolism changes and neuropsychological impairment in Parkinson disease vs Alzheimer disease.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是大脑“没电”会让人记性变差、反应变慢，看懂它，就能明白为啥老人容易糊涂，也能更早留意到这些信号。

intro.title: A comprehensive review on therapeutics and diagnostic agents targeting acetyl and butyryl cholinesterases for AD.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是，科学家正研究怎么用药物管住大脑里两种“捣乱”的酶，来缓解老年痴呆症状，帮患者和家人更清楚治疗方向。

intro.title: Metabolic therapeutic targets in Alzheimer's disease.
intro.zh: 这篇综述告诉你，老年痴呆可能和大脑“缺能量”有关，提前护好血糖和代谢，或许能帮大脑慢点老。
